## Preface {.unnumbered}

These are the lecture notes for the _Maschinelles Lernen in der industriellen Bildverarbeitung_ class, part of the _MCI | The Entrepreneurial School_ master for [Mechatronik - Automation, Robotics & AI](https://www.mci.edu/de/studium/master/mechatronik-automation-robotics-ai#im_studium) in the summer term 2025.
This is a revised version of the previous year, checkout previous version via the appropriate tag or get the pdf from the releases.

## Acknowledgements {.unnumbered}

We want to thank the open source community for providing excellent tutorials and guides for Data Science topics in and with Python on the web.
Individual sources are cited at the appropriate spot throughout the document at hand.

Furthermore, the students of the class in the summer term 2025 helped to improve these notes due to their feedback in class as well as by providing issues in the github project.

These notes are built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/).
